results.title: Who is the most famous kirtan singer?
results.snippet: Krishna Das (IAST: Kṛṣṇa dāsa; born Jeffrey Kagel; May 31, 1947) is an American vocalist known for his performances of Hindu devotional music known as kirtan (chanting the names of God). He has released seventeen albums since 1996.

results.title: What is a kirtan wallah?
results.snippet: This is an ancient spiritual practice. In India it is called “Kirtan”, which means singing and chanting the Divine Names. A “Wallah” is someone who performs an action. In this case, Kirtan Wallah refers to someone who sings Kirtan.

results.title: What is a kirtan artist?
results.snippet: It also refers to a genre of religious performance arts, connoting a musical form of narration, shared recitation, or devotional singing, particularly of spiritual or religious ideas, native to the Indian subcontinent. A person performing kirtan is known as a kirtankara (or kirtankar, कीर्तनकार).

results.title: What is the purpose of iskcon kirtan?
results.snippet: The 24 Hour Kirtan Mandali at the Krishna Balaram Mandir was inaugurated by the desire and instruction of His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Srila Prabhupada, Founder-Ācārya of ISKCON. Its purpose is to continuously generate a spiritually surcharged atmosphere that nurtures pure devotional consciousness.
